name: manual_1f4dc3
claim: A coordination handoff is a release followed by a claim with preserved lineage. Notification or inherited authorship alone neither transfers ownership nor grants the receiving actor authority.

decisions.notes: Restore the unaffected handoff rule from superseded lesson_0361f3955fb0; review5794657371. The controller remains the authoritative writer and each new claim must satisfy its own authority checks.
